biography.plain_text: Charles G. ‘Charlie’ Barker Jr. is an American automotive entrepreneur and chairman of Virginia Beach-based Charles Barker Holdings. Barker remains active in luxury vehicle retailing while directing long-running charitable programmes for Hampton Roads children.

long_biography.plain_text:
Creating the Virginia Beach Billfish Tournament gave Barker a way to combine competitive fishing with community fundraising. He secured Toyota as an early presenting sponsor and later sustained the event through Charles Barker Automotive when corporate support receded. His long-running tournament participation made sportfishing a defining interest beyond the dealership floor.

Youth opportunity became the organising theme of his civic work. Barker established Champions for Kids, chaired the Virginia Beach board of An Achievable Dream and funded scholarships for local pupils. His family later endowed a Clemson University scholarship for graduates of that school programme. Virginia also appointed him to the Motor Vehicle Dealer Board, bringing decades of retail experience to industry oversight.
